issues.description: Visible stair-step aliasing in several freshly captured Web reference images.
issues.nativeRequirement: Improve edge smoothing; preserve geometry, projection, artwork sharpness, materials, lighting and motion. Do not reproduce jagged edges or conceal them with global blur/noise.
issues.comparison: Report confirmed edge ROIs separately with paired close-ups. Improved antialiasing is an allowed and required difference; unaffected image regions and geometric anchors retain their original gates.
